title: Documents and release notes
changes: PDFs and text files can have their text extracted in the browser, with no AI service required.
Extracted text can be summarized, or used to fill the guided interview's answers — merging with what you have written, never overwriting it.
A scanned PDF with no text layer says so plainly rather than appearing to do nothing.
This 'What's new' panel, with one file per release kept in the codebase.
A page left open across a deploy now explains that the app was updated, instead of reporting a failed module import.
